title: GET /auth/config serves nine features keys the spec does not declare, and nothing pins the feature registry to the schema
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Filing gate: ① an out-of-scope finding (class b, carrier: the seat) that the #29344 dev reported and the seat's contract review confirmed on PR #29455's head `0d814466` (record 6581701011). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What was measured

PR #29455 declares `features.sso` on `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts`), the response schema of `GET /api/v1/auth/config`. The same response carries nine more `features` keys the server serves (plugin-auth `getPublicConfig()`, `auth-manager.ts`) that the schema does not declare. A client that parses the response through `GetAuthConfigResponseSchema` loses them, because a plain object schema strips unknown keys:

- booleans, all classified in `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts`): `multiOrgEnabled`, `degradedTenancy`, `oidcProvider`, `deviceAuthorization`, `admin`
- non-flag values, all listed in `PUBLIC_AUTH_CONFIG_NON_FLAG_KEYS`: `tenancyPosture`, `audiencePosture`, `termsUrl`, `privacyUrl`

`deviceAuthorization` has a live reader (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/auth/DeviceAuthPage.tsx:77`). Also undeclared, at the top level of `GetAuthConfigResponseSchema`: `devSeedAdmin` (`auth-manager.ts:4634`, dev-only).

No pin ties the registry or the non-flag list to the schema's keys. The three existing pins are: plugin-auth `public-feature-registry.test.ts` (served keys ≡ registry), platform-objects feature-gate guard (registry ≡ gates), and spec `public-auth-features.test.ts` (the registry's names). So a key can be served, classified and read while the contract never declares it, which is how `sso` (#29344) and `cloudManaged` (#25292) each needed their own card.

## Wanted

1. Declare each served key on `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` (and `devSeedAdmin` on `GetAuthConfigResponseSchema`, or rule it out as dev-only), with a describe that says what the producer means, in the #25292 / PR #29455 pattern. Each is `Clause-②: yes (widening)` · `Metadata-protocol: added`; the names are the served names, so the maintainer is asked only if a rename is proposed.
2. Add one pin in `packages/spec` that every key in `PUBLIC_AUTH_FEATURES` and `PUBLIC_AUTH_CONFIG_NON_FLAG_KEYS` is a declared key of `AuthFeaturesConfigSchema` (retired keys excepted), so the next served key cannot be left undeclared.

Reader who acts: the `packages/spec` api-schema owner (`domain:spec`). Land after PR #29455, which touches the same schema.

Also seen, for the ui lane, prose only: `ui/packages/auth/src/types.ts:284-289` documents `features.sso` as "wired; when falsy the `/sign-in/sso` route isn't mounted", but the served value is "usable", so a served `false` can mean "wired, no provider yet" with the route mounted. The type (`sso?: boolean`) is right.

Related: #29344 / PR #29455, #25292 / PR #25309.
